title: Chasing Amy
tagline: Comic book love, diner booth dinner.
about: A New Jersey comic book artist falls for a woman who doesn't fit the picture he's drawn of her.

    StartersJersey disco friesThick chips under beef gravy and melted mozzarellaHow to make it1kg potatoes2 L vegetable oil, for frying30g butter2 tbsp plain flour400ml beef stock150g mozzarella, gratedCut the potatoes into thick chips, soak and dry well.Fry in the oil at 150°C, then again at 190°C until crisp.Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the stock and simmer until thick.Pile the chips on a tray, pour over the gravy, cover with mozzarella and grill until melted.Bluntman and Chronic pizza bagelsToasted bagel halves with pizza sauce, mozzarella and pepperoniHow to make it4 plain bagels8 tbsp pizza sauce150g mozzarella, grated60g pepperoni, slicedSplit the bagels and toast lightly.Spread each half with pizza sauce and top with mozzarella and pepperoni.Grill until bubbling. Cut into halves to share.Jersey ham, egg and cheese slidersA Jersey breakfast between comic deadlinesHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thick-cut smoked ham fried until the edges curl, stacked with a soft fried egg and melted American cheese in buttered slider buns with ketchup.Cut 400g thick smoked ham into 8 slices about 5mm thick and nick the edges so they don't buckle.Fry in a buttered pan over medium heat 2 minutes a side until caramelised at the edges.Fry 8 small eggs until the whites set and yolks are jammy, adding a slice of American cheese to each for the last minute under a lid.Toast 8 buttered slider buns and stack ham, egg and cheese with a squeeze of ketchup.MainsJersey Italian hot dogsFried franks in pizza bread with fried potatoes, peppers and mustardHow to make it600g potatoes, diced3 tbsp vegetable oil2 green capsicums2 onions8 hot dog franks4 pizza bread rounds4 tbsp yellow mustardDice the potatoes and slice the capsicums and onions.Fry the potatoes in oil until golden, then add the capsicums and onions and cook until soft.Fry the franks until blistered.Split the pizza bread rounds, fill with franks and the potato and pepper mix and finish with mustard.Diner patty melt on ryeThe diner booth where Silent Bob tells his Amy storyHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin beef patties with slow-cooked caramelised onions and Swiss cheese, pressed between buttered rye and griddled until crisp and oozing, pickles alongside.Slowly cook 3 sliced onions in 30g butter with a pinch of salt over low heat for 30 minutes until jammy.Shape 600g beef mince into 4 thin oval patties and season.Sear in a hot pan 2 minutes a side.Butter 8 slices of rye on one side.On the unbuttered sides layer Swiss cheese (8 slices), a patty, onions and more cheese.Cook in a pan over medium heat, pressing, 3 minutes a side until golden and melted.Halve and serve with pickles.SweetsDiner rice puddingCreamy vanilla rice pudding, warm or cold. Painting of birds not included.How to make it150g arborio rice1 L milk80g caster sugar1 tsp vanilla extract1 tsp ground cinnamonSimmer the rice in the milk with the sugar over low heat, stirring often, until thick and creamy.Stir in the vanilla, pour into 4 glasses.Chill for the setting time.Dust with cinnamon before serving.DrinksJersey diner root beer floatRoot beer over vanilla ice cream and whipped cream, for the hockey gameHow to make it400g vanilla ice cream (8 scoops)1 L root beer, cold100ml thickened cream4 maraschino cherriesPut 4 tall glasses in the freezer to chill.Drop 2 scoops of ice cream into each glass and pour the root beer slowly down the side.Whip the cream and finish each with a swirl of cream and a cherry. Serve with a long spoon and a straw.
